exposure: Women with at least one cesarean section
Women without a history of cesarean section
cohort: 361 women who underwent thermal balloon endometrial ablation at the Kepler University Hospital, Austria, between November 2017 and December 2022
finding: Women with a history of one or more cesarean sections did not have an increased risk of complications following thermal balloon endometrial ablation compared to women without a history of cesarean section.
mod_finding: Women with a history of one or more prior cesarean sections with transverse isthmocervical hysterotomy do not appear to have an increased risk of complications during a subsequent thermal balloon endometrial ablation.
